**Finding: compliant** — no MFN obligation burdens PB.

- Targeted searches for MFN formulations ("most favoured/favorable", "no less favorable", "better terms", "terms offered to any Third Party", "match such terms", rights of first refusal) returned no MFN mechanic.
- The single "not less favorable ... to SFJ" phrase (Section 7.4, p0543) governs the terms of a replacement subordination agreement with a refinancing lender measured against the SVB subordination agreement. That is a lien-priority/secured-party protection, not a requirement that PB extend SFJ commercial terms given to third parties or match a third-party offer, so it falls outside this rule's detection scope.
- Result: the Agreement sits at the preferred position (no Customer-side MFN), and no redline was proposed.
